callees.name: new_event_id
callees.post_condition: Returns a unique string identifier in the format "<prefix>_<hex_uuid>" that is distinct from all identifiers returned by prior calls

callees.name: utc_now_iso
callees.post_condition: Returns the current date and time in UTC as an ISO 8601 formatted string

callees.name: _opencode_log_path
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is an existing directory path and event_id is a non-empty string
callees.post_condition: Returns a file path within work_dir that is unique to event_id and suitable for writing the subprocess stdout log

callees.name: _opencode_trace_path
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is an existing directory path and event_id is a non-empty string
callees.post_condition: Returns a file path within work_dir that is unique to event_id and suitable for writing raw LLM request/response traces

callees.name: _start_opencode_process
callees.signature: _start_opencode_process(proj_dir, work_dir, event_id, command, opencode_log_path) -> (Popen, Thread | None, Thread | None)
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir and work_dir are valid directory paths; command is a non-empty list of strings; opencode_log_path is a writable file path
callees.post_condition: Returns a 3-tuple of (a running subprocess.Popen instance, an optional thread streaming subprocess stdout to opencode_log_path, an optional thread feeding stdin to the subprocess). The subprocess environment includes OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT, TRACE_DIR, and LLM_API_KEY injections.

callees.name: _wait_opencode_process
callees.pre_condition: proc is a running subprocess.Popen returned by _start_opencode_process
callees.post_condition: Blocks until the subprocess terminates, then returns (exit_code, error) where exit_code is the integer process exit code and error is an error description string if the process terminated abnormally, or None if it exited normally

callees.name: command_argv
callees.pre_condition: command is a non-empty sequence of strings
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of strings with the executable as the first element, suitable for display in error messages and event records

callees.name: record_opencode_call
callees.signature: record_opencode_call(*, work_dir, event_id, stage, status, started, ended, command, function_ids, input_files, output_files, exit_code, summary, error, metadata, opencode_log_path, opencode_trace_path) -> None
callees.pre_condition: started and ended are ISO 8601 UTC timestamp strings where ended is not earlier than started; status is one of "success" or "error"; exit_code is an integer
callees.post_condition: Atomically appends one structured JSON event record to the events.jsonl file in the trace directory derived from work_dir. The record includes event_id, stage, status, started, ended, command, exit_code, and all optional metadata fields. On success the caller observes exactly one new line in events.jsonl containing the complete event.
